concepts.proposed_markdown: Adyen's NYC1 is a card reader paired with an Android or iOS mobile device running a POS app. The app starts and shows the transaction while the shopper uses the reader for tap, chip, swipe or wallet presentation. Bluetooth is the general device link. The NYC1 manual limits a **direct USB-C cable from mobile device to reader** to Android devices supporting USB host mode; the separate iOS Mobile SDK path connects the mobile device by USB-C **through an NYC1 dock with the reader seated**. A docked reader can also charge while the mobile device still connects over Bluetooth without a USB-C device-to-dock connection. See [[source-adyen-docs-point-of-sale-user-manuals-nyc1]] and [[source-adyen-docs-point-of-sale-mobile-ios-understand]]. This reader path is distinct from direct standalone-terminal initiation, apps installed on Adyen Android payment terminals, and native online-checkout SDK flows.
